02 / The Challenge

Coaching involves more than creating a plan.

A coach needs to manage exercises, nutrition content, individual requirements, and updates while making sure every client can easily access their plan.

The goal was to bring these connected tasks into one platform: a practical workspace for the coach and a clear, interactive experience for clients.

03 / The Solution

One system, built around both sides of coaching.

Spiky combines a management dashboard with a mobile-friendly client application.

The coach can organize reusable content, build personalized training and nutrition plans, and share access with individual clients. Clients can then follow their plans, review exercise instructions, and access updates in one place.

The platform also supports downloadable training and nutrition guides for clients who prefer keeping a PDF copy.

04 / Key Features

Built for the coach.

Content libraries. Organized food, exercise, recipe, and supplement libraries make existing content easier to find, reuse, and personalize.

Personalized plans. Training schedules, grouped sets, supersets, meals, and alternatives can be assembled around individual requirements.

Client management. Dedicated access links connect each client to their own plans and updates.

PDF guides. Structured training and nutrition guides can be downloaded, including QR codes linking to exercise videos.

Designed for the client.

Training made accessible. Weekly training plans include exercise references, videos, sets, rest timers, and coach notes.

Nutrition in context. Clients can review meals, alternatives, and nutrition details through their own interface.

Daily tracking. Water logging and weekly charts give clients a simple way to follow their hydration activity.

A connected experience. Plan updates can be reflected in the client's application without repeatedly sending replacement documents.

06 / The Outcome

From separate coaching tasks to one connected workflow.

Spiky was completed, delivered, and put into use by the coach.

The delivered platform brings together the coach's content management, personalized plan creation, interactive client experience, and downloadable guides.

Its content libraries include 151 food items, 101 exercises, 10 muscle groups, 47 recipes, and 10 supplements. These figures describe the content available in the platform, not business growth metrics.

Technology: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Supabase, Vercel Serverless Functions, Puppeteer.

Client Feedback: The coach's feedback highlighted ease of use and positive responses from the trainees using the platform.
